review.notes: Structure audit: no code fences; all 30+ headings checked against the PDF text layer; exactly three figure-internal level-1 headings were found (Fig. 8/Fig. 13 grid column labels, counted as two occurrences of one string, and Fig. 9 row+column labels), each demoted after visual confirmation on rendered p.18, p.21, p.26 and p.27. The seven OCR <table> elements reproduce Tables 1-7 including the Edit3D-Bench values (0.0684/0.0091, 0.2729/0.6515, 86.7%); spot-checked against the PDF text. Droppage: normalized 10-gram diff of all 33 pages found no missing prose; non-matches are hyphenation splits, citation ranges transcribed as math, figure-internal labels of the embedded pipeline figures (Fig. 1-7, 10-12) and the page-1 teaser infographic line ("87M Training Samples..."), which stays plain text below its image. All 118 reference entries are present. The vertical arXiv sidebar stamp on p.1 is not transcribed, matching project convention.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.18 (Fig. 8) and p.27 (Fig. 13) each show a four-column qualitative text-to-3D grid printed as one embedded image with column labels "Ours / Omni123 / Universe3D / Trellis"; the labels never occur in the PDF text layer. The OCR promoted them to a level-1 heading in both places (before Fig. 8's caption and before Fig. 13's row prompts); demoted to plain text on both occurrences.
